request.text: For calls at my desk I need a new wired USB-A headset with a microphone and a physical mute control. Can you find one for at most $60 including delivery to Byblos?

message:
Best match: Technodel’s Logitech H390 USB-A (black), in stock at $26.00 plus $4 delivery to Byblos: $30 delivered, comfortably below your $60 limit.
Confirmed new, wired USB-A, noise-cancelling boom microphone, and physical volume/mute controls on the cable. VAT treatment is not stated.
Alternative: iSolved IT Solutions has a new H390 in black for $33.00, VAT included, with in-line mute. Delivery covers Lebanon, but shipping is calculated at checkout, so its delivered total is unconfirmed.
I suggest the Technodel offer: it has the clearest verified fit and published delivery fee.
